kaliwa-kanan.note: OSRM car routing over all 20 stops. OSM relations 337589/337590 map only the in-campus segment, so they were not adopted.

forestry.note: OSRM car routing over the 14 stops on the road, with the dorm loop forced down Makiling Road, along Valentin Sajor and up Felix O. Chinte Sr. Stops placed from OSM and the owner's corrections on 2026-10-06.

up-rural.note: OSRM car routing over the 8 stops: Pili Drive, then IPB Road, Road North 1 and Sampaguita Street to Jubileeville. No IRRI or Putho detour (owner correction, 2026-10-06).

uplb-to-upd.note: OSRM car routing through the stops: SLEX, Skyway, Quezon Ave. and Commonwealth to UP Diliman. OSM relations 17932246/17932247 map a C-5/Katipunan path and were not used.
uplb-to-upd.caveat: Drawn by road routing through the stops along SLEX, the Skyway and Quezon Ave.; the streets inside UP Diliman may differ.

upd-to-uplb.note: OSRM car routing through the stops: SLEX, Skyway, Quezon Ave. and Commonwealth to UP Diliman. OSM relations 17932246/17932247 map a C-5/Katipunan path and were not used.
upd-to-uplb.caveat: Drawn by road routing through the stops along SLEX, the Skyway and Quezon Ave.; the streets inside UP Diliman may differ.

lb-to-sta-cruz.note: OSM route relation 2582682 — PUJ Calamba → Santa Cruz, trimmed to the Los Baños leg.
lb-to-sta-cruz.caveat: Traced from the mapped Calamba-origin jeepney corridor and cut at this route's own end points, so the ends are approximate.

lb-to-san-pablo.note: OSM route relation 1856207 — PUJ Calamba → San Pablo, trimmed to the Los Baños leg.
lb-to-san-pablo.caveat: Traced from the mapped Calamba-origin jeepney corridor and cut at this route's own end points, so the ends are approximate.

lb-to-calamba.note: OSM route relation 1856209 — PUJ Calamba → UP Los Baños, reversed (the return relation 1856216 is tagged disused).
lb-to-calamba.caveat: Only the opposite direction of this jeepney is mapped, so the line is the return trip drawn backwards. One-way streets near the terminals may differ in practice.

lb-to-buendia.note: OSRM car routing between stops; no OSM route relation covers this service.

buendia-to-lb.note: OSRM car routing between stops; no OSM route relation covers this service.
